description: Returns one published product record: composition as the label states it, daily amounts, the applicable upper limit of the country for each ingredient with its share, limits of other countries, the status in the country, prices per day where published, and the dates of each part.

country.description: Two-letter country for limits, status and published local prices. Defaults to the product URL country when supplied, otherwise the label market. Viewing a record does not confirm local sale or delivery.

id.description: Verateca product id, e.g. "US:302778", as returned by search_products.

url.description: Verateca product page address, as an alternative to id.

name: get_product
title: Get product
